content.text:
I haven't confirmed the cause of the 502, and none of these changes has been compiled or run.

The 502 on `GET /api/users/{id}/portfolio` came after the user was created, so the gateway → user-service route worked. My best guess is that trade-service called user-service or market-service through Feign before Eureka and the load balancer had seen that instance. That produces a 503, which my code mapped to 502. The failure body doesn't show which service returned the 502, so a bug in the portfolio code is still possible.

Changes made, none of them touching Compose or the public API:
- **Retries:** in `TradeController`, the read-only calls (user lookup and quote) now retry up to 8 times, one second apart, when the downstream call fails with anything other than 400 or 404. Those two still map straight to 400 and 404. Each failed attempt is logged with its Feign error. The buy and sell `apply` call is not retried, because it isn't safe to repeat.
- **Faster discovery:** all four Eureka client configs (trade-service, user-service, market-service, api-gateway) now fetch the registry every 3 seconds and renew their lease every 3 seconds.
- **No instance caching:** the load-balancer instance cache is disabled in trade-service and api-gateway.

If T03 still returns 502, the "Downstream call failed" warnings in the trade-service logs will show the real underlying error.
